name: President
tagline: Get rid of your cards first. Presidents rule; the Scum hands over their best.
rulesSummary: Be first to get rid of all your cards. Everything is dealt. 2 is the highest card, then A K Q … down to 3.
Whoever holds the 3♣ leads the first hand. Play one card or a set of one rank. Each play after must be the same number of cards and higher. Or pass — you can still play later in the same round.
When everyone else passes, the pile is cleared and whoever played last leads anything. Nothing beats a 2.
First out is President (2 points), next Vice-President (1). Last is the Scum, next-to-last the Vice-Scum. First to 11 points wins; a tie at the top plays on.
Next hand, play goes in order of rank, from the President round to the Scum. The Scum deals.
The Scum hands the President their 2 best cards and gets 2 of the President's choice back (1 card between Vice-Scum and Vice-President). Then the President leads.
With three there are no Vices: the middle player is a Citizen and scores nothing. Only the Scum and the President swap cards.
